hits.title: Sift Names Co-Founder Austin Spiegel as CEO and Opens San Francisco Office
hits.snippet: Sift Names Co-Founder Austin Spiegel as CEO and Opens San Francisco Office Accessibility Statement Skip Navigation ... MARINA DEL REY, Calif., May 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Sift, the data infrastructure platform for physical AI, today announced that co-founder Austin Spiegel has been named Chief Executive Officer. The company also announced the opening of a second office in downtown San Francisco and the addition of senior leaders from Meta, Anduril, Applied Intuition, Grafana Labs, SpaceX, and Palantir to its 80-person team. Co-founder Karthik Gollapudi will shift his focus to product vision and industry evangelism.

hits.snippet: Karthik Gollapudi ... Sift / Founders / 02Karthik Gollapudi · Austin Spiegel ... Cofounder & CEO ... ## Austin Spiegel ... Austin Spiegel is the co-founder of Sift, where he leads engineering, technical strategy, and go-to-market. He studied computer science at the University of Southern California before joining SpaceX, where he spent nearly five years building mission-critical software across rocket and spacecraft manufacturing, and tools for developing and operating the Starlink satellite constellation. ... After a year as a software engineering manager at Riot Games, Austin reconnected with co-founder Karthik Gollapudi and began building Sift from the conviction that the data infrastructure behind SpaceX's engineering culture should be available to every hardware company. He is based in Los Angeles. ... ## Karthik Gollapudi ... Karthik Gollapudi is the co-founder of Sift, the data infrastructure platform built for hardware engineering teams. Growing up near JPL, he developed an early passion for making science fiction a reality, competing in FIRST Robotics before studying computer science.
